ex.en: The nurse put an IV in his arm to give him fluids.
ex.zh: 護士在他的手臂上插了點滴，給他補充水分。

ex.en: She was still on an IV when I visited her in the hospital.
ex.zh: 我到醫院探望她時，她還在打點滴。

ex.en: Trading ivory is illegal in most countries.
ex.zh: 在大多數國家，買賣象牙是違法的。

ex.en: The old piano keys were made of ivory.
ex.zh: 那架老鋼琴的琴鍵是用象牙做的。

ex.en: She wore an ivory dress to the wedding.
ex.zh: 她穿著一件乳白色的洋裝參加婚禮。

ex.en: The walls were painted a soft ivory color.
ex.zh: 牆壁被漆成柔和的乳白色。

ex.en: Green ivy covered the old stone wall.
ex.zh: 綠色的常春藤爬滿了老石牆。

ex.en: The house was so old that ivy grew up to the roof.
ex.zh: 這間房子很老舊，常春藤一路爬到屋頂。
